name: Web Application Firewall policy
summary: WAF policy with the OWASP managed rule set and custom rules, attached to an Application Gateway or Front Door.
useWhen: You need OWASP-based protection (SQLi, XSS, etc.) in front of a web app
You need custom WAF rules, e.g. blocking specific countries or IP ranges
avoidWhen: You're not fronting traffic with Application Gateway or Front Door (this policy has nothing to attach to)
